results.question: Hi, I'm emma.devries@example.com. Can I still return my order ORD-1001?

results.question: My espresso machine from order ORD-1005 stopped working. Is it still under warranty? Email: julia.smit@example.com
results.reply:
Yes, your espresso machine is still under warranty. Order ORD-1005 was delivered on 16 September 2025, and the machine has a 24-month warranty, so it runs until 16 September 2027. Warranty claims are handled by our human support team, and they are free for you, including shipping. Would you like me to pass your claim on? If so, please briefly describe the fault (for example, whether it doesn't turn on, leaks, or doesn't heat up).
